title: Members
description: Everyone in {workspace}, their roles, and the teams you share with.
adminsInviteAsk: Only admins can invite people. Ask {name}.
noMatchesHint: Try a name, an email or a job title.

seats.label: Seats
seats.breakdownPending: · {members, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}, {pending, plural, one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}
seats.left: {count, plural, one {# seat left.} other {# seats left.}} Pending invitations hold a seat until they’re accepted or revoked.
seats.fullAdd: All seats are taken. Add seats to invite more people.
seats.fullAsk: All seats are taken. Ask the owner to add seats.

member.idle: {days, plural, one {Inactive for # day or more} other {Inactive for # days or more}}
member.removeDescription: Meetings and files {name} shared from their own Notes and File Manager leave with them. Tasks stay, and their open ones become unassigned. The seat frees up.

teams.emptyHint: Teams are optional. Create them when you want to share meetings and knowledge with a group, like Engineering or Sales.
teams.intro: Share meetings and knowledge with a team instead of one person at a time.
teams.deleteDescription: Its meetings stay visible to the people who took part, and its members stay in the workspace. Move the team’s knowledge first; it can’t be left without an audience.

team.membersLedBy: {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} · led by {name}
team.membersLedByYou: {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} · led by you

teamForm.description: Share meetings and knowledge with a group instead of one by one.
teamForm.privateHint: Only its members and admins see it and what’s shared with it.

invite.title: Invite people to {workspace}
invite.description: They’ll get an email with a link to join. Each person takes a seat.
invite.hint: Separate addresses with commas or new lines. {left, plural, one {# seat left.} other {# seats left.}}
invite.overSeats: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}, but only {left, plural, one {# seat left.} other {# seats left.}}
invite.seatsAfter: {count, plural, one {# invitation} other {# invitations}} · {left, plural, one {# seat left after this.} other {# seats left after this.}}
invite.allExisting: They’re already in the workspace or invited.
invite.tooMany: {count, plural, one {Invite at most # person at once.} other {Invite at most # people at once.}}

toasts.invitationsSent: {count, plural, one {Invitation sent to {email}} other {# invitations sent}}
toasts.roleChanged: {role, select, admin {{name} is now an admin} other {{name} is now a member}}
